content:
**Bandolier** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Bandolier reduces the weight of all ammo used by ballistic weapons, excluding 2mm electromagnetic cartridges and including cannonballs.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Ballistic weapon ammo weighs 90% less. | 003896E4 | 
| ★ | 1 | Ballistic weapon ammo weighs 45% less. | 003896E3 | 

Ballistic ammo weight can be reduced by a maximum of 90%. If Bandolier 2 is equipped, the Reduced ammo weight legendary effect will not decrease the weight any further.

A bandolier is a pocketed belt for holding ammunition, making it easier to carry ammo around.
